title: The Stave Master's Handbook
summary: A handbook for practised staff fighters that raises basic work to full-body qi and linked sequences.

title: Linked Strikes and Counters for the Long Stave
summary: A course of linked strikes and counters for the long stave, each flowing into the next without pause.

title: Treatise on Holding the Line with a Stave
summary: Teaches a stave-bearer to hold a line against several attackers using guards, sweeps and controlled steps.

title: The Long Stave Against the Armoured Foe
summary: Shows how qi-driven blows from a long stave reach past armour to the body beneath.

title: Fieldwork of the Stave and Qi Together
summary: A manual on extending qi into a field around the stave so strikes and guards act beyond the wood.

title: Twin-Track Stave: The Paired Guard and Strike
summary: Teaches two tracks of the stave, a guard track and a strike track, run together in paired motions.

title: River-Bend Staff Forms
summary: A set of flowing forms where the stave bends its path like a river, turning blows along curved lines.

title: Hawk and Stave: Dual-Track Stooping Strikes
summary: Teaches the hawk's stoop applied to the stave: a high watching guard and a sudden diving strike.

title: Basin Court Method for Twin Staves of Qi
summary: A court method in which the stave and a field of qi act as twin weapons to guard and strike.

title: Wind-Sworn Stave: Bearings of the Plateau
summary: Teaches the wind-sworn stave fighter to take a bearing and hold it with sweeping strikes and steady guards.

title: Oath of the Open Plateau: Stave Without Walls
summary: Teaches the stave for open ground, where there are no walls to fight beside and every guard moves with the body.

title: Wind-Reading Stave of the Far Shore
summary: Teaches the stave fighter to read the wind and the opponent's motion and strike where the force turns.

title: Treatise of the Wind-Sworn Hundred-Strike Staff
summary: A demanding wind-sworn discipline that trains an unbroken storm of stave strikes carried on qi and bearing.
